description_en: Queries the monitoring data of an accelerated domain name. Data is collected every day. You can query data collected within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainsUsageByDay查询加速域名天粒度的监控统计数据，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDomainsUsageByDay

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.

If you do not specify an accelerated domain name, the data of all accelerated domain names that belong to your account is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，只支持填写一个域名。

默认查询当前用户下所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
